review_type: author-assistant instrument self-review; not independent human peer review
scope: implementation, outcome attribution, replay trust boundaries, prospective analysis and release guards; empirical gates are independently required by readiness.json
resolved_findings: V0 replay restored to all five supplied commands, rather than unit-only scoring
Lockfile-only changes and interrupted generation require adjudication rather than automatic functional failure
Source capture quiesces disposable app-container processes to stop background edits
Visible/final checks use actual transports; billing cron exercises the common synthetic upstream with HTTP and recorded calls
Qualification and rehearsal reuse are bound to exact artifacts/image; solution and baseline package contents are checked against manifests
Fault readiness requires the named old-behavior assertion, not an unrelated failure
Missing outcomes retain planned-slot bounds; no replacement or outcome-dependent task exclusion
Absent/stale start release cannot launch tools/models; model session nesting is disabled/prohibited
Manuscript prospective method updated and compiled without undefined citations/references or overfull boxes; original citation commands retained
Candidate sources are staged before runtime startup; the old HMR candidate setup cannot satisfy current qualification or V0 reuse
Freeze retains all qualification/rehearsal evidence and V0 reuse origins; future reuse points to immutable run summaries
Completion runs the full required reliability matrix directly and preserves the same counts and all five V0 commands
Known-exhausted or unavailable quota stops before recording an invocation; negative tests exercise this boundary
Frozen artifacts and image are rechecked before each unstarted slot
Billing/QR HTTP checks precede dev shutdown; typecheck/unit/build run without concurrent dev writes
remaining_scope_limits: Six constructed tasks from one repository; no task-population or general starter-kit recommendation
Cold/warm Turbopack development environment and common synthetic SePay/clock adapter are part of the setting
A locale/custom write transport unsupported by an oracle needs documented same-patch measurement adaptation
Scorer setup errors require baseline-control adjudication; no automatic attribution to agent
Credentials are excluded from capture paths; any future public trace release still needs sensitive-data review
The operational 20/30-round stability criterion cannot guarantee low flake rates
A Webpack JSON manifest failure was not reproduced by added diagnostics; Turbopack is an operational mitigation, not a proven root-cause fix
reviewed: 2026-11-16 final instrument self-review after all48 qualification and24 no-model rehearsals; not independent peer review
